Watchdog __trap on bad byte count

1 CTA/SM was worst (bs1 GEMM1 36-45 us); activations prefetched only one step ahead

name: E5
implemented: M13: stream-K M11 with continuous pipeline, lossless re-layout (9 instr/word), FP32 scratch + atomics
PDL on GEMM2 and a CUDA post-norm
Stage search and e2e per class 1-64 tokens
worked: M13 3-11% faster than M11/v1 in some classes; PDL worth 3-4 us (bs1 46.3 -> 43.2 us)
More CTAs per SM always helped (bs8 GEMM1 c1 101 -> c4 58.5 us)
failed: Every PDL config failed the FP32 check (hoisted __ldg loads above griddepcontrol.wait)
GEMM1 still ~2.0-3.0 TB/s wall, same as M11; no class switched
verdict: M13 reaches M11's bandwidth wall; PDL bug found and fixed afterward.

name: E6
implemented: M14: large-batch (32-320 tokens) kernel on M13 machinery, 4-warp CTA, swizzled shared-memory activations
8 instances; stage search incl. PDL variants

CTAs per SM decided everything (bs256 GEMM1 c1 637.9, c2 388.7, c3 318.8 us)
failed: M14 only ties Marlin at 128/256 (359.5 vs 358.6, 455.4 vs 440.9 us)
Every PDL variant failed validation (pre-fix code)
Wide tiles lost (n8 GEMM1 bs256 608.7 us)
verdict: M14 ties Marlin at large batch, which is decode-bound; kernel_fn unchanged.

name: E8
implemented: Self-tuning prepare(): M13 x L2 prefetch x PDL, M14 stage search
Tuner switches only if >=3% faster and passes FP32 check
Bandwidth recon (torch sum, plain stream, M13 math/loads-only)

failed: No class switched; M13 ~10% slower than in E5 (bs1 52.7 vs 43.2 us)
Prefetch-ahead hurt (1.60 -> 1.47 TB/s GEMM1 bs1)
Decode + MMA add 30-50% on top of loads
verdict: Tuner kept all incumbents; memory side at small-transfer ceiling, math is slow.

name: E9
implemented: PDL-safe loads via token from griddepcontrol.wait
M15: TMA weight ring, one pass up to 64/128 pairs, cost-weighted split

M13 still 53.4 us at bs1 (E5 43.2): L1 theory later disproved

M15/M17 small instances (NT 1/2, R 2, 3 CTAs/SM)

M13 prefetches slower in every class (bs1 53.8 vs 60.7 us)
Tuner wins of 4-5% vanished: bs32/bs128 ~2% slower than E9
verdict: Switched classes didn't hold on the judge; 3% margin is inside tuner error.

name: E13

Double-buffering identical to non-DB (n4c2 241 vs 241 us at bs32)
ptxas likely serializing wgmma
verdict: RS-wgmma serialized by ptxas; incumbents kept.
